description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the AccessFlowStateMachineService in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various methods like retrieving allowed actions, workflow items, next states, and CRUD operations related to workflow state machines, primarily focusing on the service layer's interaction with its DAO layer.

classes.name: AccessFlowStateMachineServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the functionality of AccessFlowStateMachineService methods, including DAO interactions, data retrieval, and CRUD operations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating a new instance of the service and populating test data from a fixture file.

methods.name: testGetAccessFlowStateMachineDao
methods.description: Verifies that the service correctly returns an instance of AccessFlowStateMachineDao.

methods.name: testSetAccessFlowStateMachineDao
methods.description: Tests the setter method for injecting a DAO and confirms the service retrieves the correct DAO instance.

methods.name: testGetAllowedActions
methods.description: Checks that the service correctly fetches allowed actions from the DAO based on flow, state, and role.

methods.name: testGetAllowedWorkflowItems
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of workflow items for specified flow, state, and role.

methods.name: testGetNextState
methods.description: Validates that the service can fetch the next state given flow, current state, role, and action.

methods.name: testGetActionableStates
methods.description: Ensures the service correctly returns states that are actionable given flow, role, and actions.

methods.name: testSaveWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Tests saving a WorkflowStateMachine record through the service.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Validates deletion of a workflow state machine record based on flow, state, role, action, and resulting state.

methods.name: testGetWorkFlowStateMachineRecordsService
methods.description: Checks retrieval of workflow state machine records for a specific flow.

methods.name: testIsActionAllowedService
methods.description: Verifies the service's ability to determine if an action is permitted based on DAO response.

methods.name: testGetWorkflowItemsByStateActionAndRole
methods.description: Ensures the DAO correctly retrieves a workflow item matching given state, action, and role.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRole
methods.description: Tests deletion of workflow records associated with a particular user role.

methods.name: testHandleUserRoleRename
methods.description: Validates the handling of user role renaming within workflow records.
